answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks using distance-bounding proof-of-location protocols. Agents establish identity by exchanging nanosecond radio challenges with verified anchors, whether tracking a wildfire ember, traversing a desert dune, or surveying a lotus wetland. This forces adversaries to deploy dedicated physical transceivers at distinct geographic sites per identity. However, colluding attackers can spoof presence by tunneling signals through low-latency optical wormholes.
